title: Checkpointed migration, reconciled cutover, retry, and restore evidence
trustBoundaries: Historical records cross into a canonical snapshot through a deterministic cursor and checksum.
Cutover authority crosses only after reconciliation, restore evidence, and two accountable approvals.
failureModes: Duplicate identity, source exception, checksum mismatch, and missing approval keep cutover closed.
Exhausted delivery enters quarantine with an explicit recovery owner.
